items.name: intelligo
items.title: Intelligo design system
items.description: The base every Intelligo page is built on (ADR-0013): shadcn base-nova on Base UI, the neutral theme with its focus ring, muted text and destructive raised to WCAG AA, and additive tokens for status (success, warning, info, destructive-foreground), layers and motion. Initialise an app from it before installing any other item.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The one page title every Intelligo page renders: heading, description and actions (ADR-0013, T4).

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A metric on a card — label, value, an action such as a status badge, and a footer (ADR-0013, T4).

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: A status shown in a status token — neutral, info, success, warning or destructive — never a palette colour (ADR-0013, T4).

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy to the clipboard with confirmation and a live announcement; labels are passed in, so it carries no copy of its own (ADR-0013, T4).

items.name: ai-code-block
items.title: AI Code Block
items.description: Highlighted code with a copy action, light and dark (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-tool
items.title: AI Tool
items.description: A tool call: name, state as a status badge, input and output (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-reasoning
items.title: AI Reasoning
items.description: Streamed reasoning, collapsible, with the time it took (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-sources
items.title: AI Sources
items.description: The sources a reply cites, collapsible (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-suggestion
items.title: AI Suggestion
items.description: Conversation starters and follow-ups in a scrollable row (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-artifact
items.title: AI Artifact
items.description: A generated document's frame: header, actions and content (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: ai-prompt-input
items.title: AI Prompt Input
items.description: The chat composer: autosizing textarea that sends on Enter, attachments by picker, drop and paste, an action menu, selects, and a submit that stops a streaming reply (ADR-0013, T3; ported from Vercel AI Elements).

items.name: smoke
items.title: Registry Smoke Test
items.description: Permanent canary item that proves the registry build and install pipeline end to end.

items.name: route-error
items.title: Route Error States
items.description: The app's error surfaces: a shared RouteError component every error.tsx renders, message-based error classification, an (app) group boundary, a translated 404, and a dependency-free global-error. Error reporting goes through the lib/error-reporting.ts seam (a no-op until you bind a reporter), so no SDK enters the registry. Items that ship an error.tsx depend on this one - install it first.

items.name: team-settings
items.title: Team Settings
items.description: Workspace team management: invite members, change roles, remove members, and manage pending invitations, backed by the framework's team service.

items.name: usage
items.title: Usage
items.description: Workspace usage dashboard: current-period summary tiles, a period selector, and a table of recent AI execution records.

items.name: invitation-accept
items.title: Invitation Accept
items.description: Accept or decline a workspace invitation via the team service. Requires the team-settings item (provides lib/team.ts and the role badge); install it first.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Authenticated application shell: session and onboarding gate, workspace bootstrap, and a collapsible sidebar with workspace switcher, configurable nav, and user menu.

items.name: settings-shell
items.title: Settings Shell
items.description: The shared frame around every /settings page: layout with heading and width constraint, a configurable tab bar (lib/settings-nav.ts), and a /settings index that redirects to the first tab. Install alongside the settings items - without it they render unframed and plain /settings links 404.

items.name: workspace-settings
items.title: Workspace Settings
items.description: Workspace name/URL editing and owner-only deletion, backed by the framework's workspace service.

items.name: auth-login
items.title: Auth: Login
items.description: Email/password and OAuth login. Ships the shared auth route layout, the de-branded AuthCard shell, and the auth-validation.ts zod schemas reused by auth-signup, auth-password-reset, and auth-email-verification - install this item first.

items.name: auth-signup
items.title: Auth: Signup
items.description: Email/password and OAuth account creation. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell, SocialLoginButtons, and lib/auth-validation.ts schemas); install it first. Redirects to auth-email-verification's /verify-email route when the server requires email verification.

items.name: auth-password-reset
items.title: Auth: Password Reset
items.description: Forgot-password and reset-password pages, backed by the Better-Auth client SDK's requestPasswordReset/resetPassword actions. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell and lib/auth-validation.ts schemas); install it first.

items.name: auth-email-verification
items.title: Auth: Email Verification
items.description: Post-signup email verification status page with a resend control, backed by the Better-Auth client SDK's sendVerificationEmail action. Reads the ?error=/?email= search params Better-Auth's own /verify-email link handler redirects back with. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell); install it first.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language Switcher
items.description: Locale dropdown over the locales i18n/routing.ts declares, labeled with each language's own name. Renders nothing in a single-locale deployment, so it is safe to mount unconditionally (e.g. in shellConfig.headerRight). Adding a locale to routing.ts plus a messages directory is the whole job.

items.name: trial-banner
items.title: Trial Banner
items.description: Dismissable trial-status strip for the app shell's bannerTop seam: days and credits remaining with an upgrade CTA, urgency-ramped visuals, dismiss-for-today, and a consumer config (lib/trial-banner-config.ts) for the CTA target and route suppression (hidden on /chat by default). Bind TrialBannerContainer as shellConfig.bannerTop.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: Notification bell with an unread badge and dropdown, plus a full notifications page with mark-as-read and load-more, backed by the framework's notification records.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plan comparison and upgrade page with a monthly/yearly toggle, backed by the framework's checkout service and the product's registered plan catalogue. Ships the lib/billing.ts product binding and actions/billing.ts checkout actions that the checkout and billing-settings items also depend on — install this item first.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Checkout-success page that verifies the Stripe session directly through the framework's checkout service, covering the webhook-race window between the browser redirect and Stripe's webhook delivery.

items.name: billing-settings
items.title: Billing Settings
items.description: Workspace billing management: current plan, credit balance, credit bundle purchase, and the Stripe billing portal, shaped server-side by role (member/admin/owner). Requires the pricing item (provides lib/billing.ts and actions/billing.ts); install it first.

items.name: feature-gating
items.title: Feature Gating
items.description: The vocabulary for selling a plan: a server-side FeatureGate that renders gated content only to entitled workspaces, three densities of upgrade prompt (full, compact, inline), a quota warning that escalates as a limit approaches, and a preview paywall that blurs content instead of hiding it. Which features exist and which plan unlocks them is consumer config (lib/feature-catalog.ts). Install pricing or billing-settings for somewhere to send the user.

items.name: payment-poll
items.title: QR Payment (poll)
items.description: The non-card checkout the catalogue was missing: issue an invoice, show a QR the user scans in their banking app, poll until the provider confirms. Provider-agnostic — QPay, SocialPay, PIX, UPI, PromptPay all fit — through the lib/local-payment.ts binding. Requires the pricing item for lib/billing-config.ts's CURRENCY.

items.name: profile-settings
items.title: Profile Settings
items.description: User profile name editing, read-only email, and account deletion with typed confirmation, backed by the framework's profile service.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A generic multi-step onboarding wizard driven by a consumer-owned steps config: text and single-select-card fields, a completion screen, skip, and back/next - backed by the framework's onboarding service (durable step progress, no vertical-specific UI).

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: An AI-first workspace home: a hero with starter prompts, a sticky prompt bar that opens a new conversation, a resume affordance for unfinished work, recent conversations, and a compact plan/usage strip. Configurable through lib/dashboard-config.tsx (copy, starters, chat base path, shortcuts) and lib/dashboard-data.ts (what "resume" means). Pairs with the chat item for its /chat routes and the pricing item for lib/billing-config.ts's CURRENCY; install those first.

items.name: artifacts
items.title: Artifacts
items.description: Browse and manage AI-generated document artifacts: filterable list, full-content preview, copy-to-clipboard, and version delete, backed by the framework's document persistence service.

items.name: privacy-settings
items.title: Privacy Settings
items.description: GDPR-style data export, a read-only memory-audit trail, and per-category fact listing with delete, backed by the framework's identity service.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A self-contained AI chat surface: streaming conversation UI, a history switcher, a tool-call renderer seam you own, and a two-line Route Handler that binds @intelligo-dev/chat's transport — auth, rate limit, feature gate, persistence and the execution boundary — to consumer-owned config (lib/chat-server-config.ts). Ships with a deterministic stub model so a clean install streams with no API keys. The config imports lib/intelligo.ts (the composition root) and lib/plans.ts, which are provided by the `intelligo create` scaffold, not by any registry item - in a hand-rolled app, create both before installing (see the CLI's app-scaffold templates).
